uutiset.t: DR Congo says military aircraft missing as rebels claim to shoot down plane
uutiset.s: A South African fighter pilot and a Ugandan officer are reportedly among those aboard the downed plane.

uutiset.t: Nigerian monarch, 92, suspended after sexual assault claims
uutiset.s: The Emir of Daura is one of Nigeria's best-known monarchs, with politicians often trying to gain his support.

uutiset.t: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
uutiset.s: Nvidia's share price have fallen 7% as lawmakers demand answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in Huang's reinstatement.

uutiset.t: Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
uutiset.s: Saurav Das says immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him his passport had been flagged.

uutiset.t: Zimbabwean convicted in South Africa of trying to fight in Ukraine
uutiset.s: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.

uutiset.t: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
uutiset.s: It is the latest case involving Nicolas Sarkozy who became the first French ex-president to go to jail last year.

uutiset.t: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
uutiset.s: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had been in the post for two months, is among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes on Tuesday.

uutiset.t: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
uutiset.s: Nearly 1,000 children are among those killed or injured by explosives left over from the conflict, figures show.

uutiset.t: Russian governor detained in rare criminal case against regional leader
uutiset.s: Andrei Chibis, head of Russia's northern Murmansk region, is the first governor to be detained for five years.

uutiset.t: Car bomb tears through Colombian city wounding more than 20
uutiset.s: The explosion is the latest in a string of attacks on buildings housing the security forces and government offices.

uutiset.t: Pope Francis' diary reveals claims he saw the devil three times
uutiset.s: Published extracts from the late pontiff's diary claim one of the visions happened "in the choir loft" during Mass.

uutiset.t: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
uutiset.s: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

uutiset.t: Watch: Moment troops raid home and capture Mexican drug lord
uutiset.s: Newly-released bodycam footage shows the moment troops detained 'El Chapo Isidro', who had managed to evade capture for years.

uutiset.t: What Jensen Huang's return teaches China's Xi about Trump
uutiset.s: Huang being back at the helm of Nvidia is no guarantee of relief for Beijing.

uutiset.t: Bangladesh's ex-PM Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return on 16 December
uutiset.s: Hasina has spoken several times of her desire to return, but this is the first time she has set a date.
